summary: Completed comprehensive testing of AI Crime Prediction System with Leaflet maps, Claude Sonnet 4.5 AI integration, and glassmorphism UI. Backend APIs 100% functional, core frontend features working excellently.

ui_bugs.issue: JWT tokens expire quickly (15 min) causing frequent re-login during testing
